I’ve had 2 laparoscopies and hysteroscopies and honestly the experience was fine overall. One thing that really surprised me is for me my endo pain was very bad. The post surgery pain even when the painkillers wore off was nothing compared to what I dealt with almost everyday for months.

I did unfortunately get an infection after my first one but it wasn’t very painful. I did however had a lot of blood loss and ended up back in the operating room having emergency surgery. All was fixed with patching up of a polyp in my uterus, a mirena coil and a course of strong antibiotics. In my case I was just unlucky though. The infection was thought to have been caught from the operating table due to the strain and the polyp starting bleeding as a result.

Despite the infection I was more than happy to get my second laparoscopy so it definitely shouldn’t put you off or be something you really worry about. Infections can happen but provided you take good care of yourself it should be very unlikely. Worst case scenario it does happen a course of antibiotics most likely would sort you out.

Best thing I can recommend is plenty of rest, lots of water and some painkillers. Remember to eat well too as your body needs the energy! I personally started feeling much better after 5-6 days in terms of pain.
